meta.title: [DataGrid] Add IsFixed parameter
meta.body_summary: Add IsFixed parameter to FluentDataGrid to skip hash‑based change detection for static datasets, reducing unnecessary CPU cycles and automatic refreshes.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added IsFixed parameter to skip hash computation; maintainers requested complete hash removal and explicit default; agent iterated and approvals given, but PR closed without merge for unknown reason.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 393 changed lines across 16 files, this is a small-to-medium change. It is a targeted performance optimization for the FluentDataGrid component, but despite receiving multiple approvals, the PR was closed without merge; the reason is not evident from review text, which is atypical.

review_details.concern_detail: vnbaaij requested removal of explicit default value assignment, then asked to remove hash calculation and comparisons entirely, relying only on IsFixed to control refresh. Copilot complied in follow-up commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Skip hash computation for static datasets to reduce unnecessary CPU cycles and automatic refreshes.
review_details.rejection_signals: Despite multiple approvals, the PR was closed without merge; no explicit rejection reason provided in review text.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully iterated on maintainer feedback to simplify hash removal, demonstrating understanding of Blazor component lifecycle. However, the PR was ultimately closed despite approvals, indicating a possible process disconnect.

detection_detail.code_reading: vnbaaij reviewed the parameter addition, requested removal of explicit default and complete hash removal; later dvoituron approved.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests cover IsFixed behaviour, but no benchmark or profiling data is provided to quantify the performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, Copilot removed explicit default and later removed hash computation entirely per maintainer request; all feedback addressed within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Add boolean IsFixed parameter to FluentDataGrid; when true, skip hash-based change detection and rely solely on parameter to control automatic refresh, removing ComputeItemsHash method and hash comparison logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commits brought in unrelated DataGrid page updates, demo files, and JavaScript modifications; core performance change is isolated in FluentDataGrid.razor.cs.
change_trajectory: Initial commit adds IsFixed parameter and basic refresh logic.
Maintainer requests removal of hash calculation; Copilot first skips hash when IsFixed=true.
Maintainer requests complete removal of hash computation; Copilot deletes ComputeItemsHash and all hash-based detection.
Maintainer asks to remove explicit default value; Copilot removes `= false` assignment.
Multiple approvals given, but PR closed without merge.
